caption: First page of Initiative Petition 34 as filed with the Oregon Secretary of State's Elections Division, July 2, 2019, later enacted as Ballot Measure 109.
alt: Typed page headed 'AN ACT, Be It Enacted by the People of the State of Oregon' with Section 1 findings, stamped 'RECEIVED, 2 Jul 2019, 4:39 PM, Elections Division, Secretary of State' inside an outline of Oregon.
credit: Oregon Secretary of State, Elections Division
note: The draft's recorded sourceUrl points to the codified statute, not a scan; this is the filed initiative petition text (IP 34) that became Measure 109, with the Secretary of State's receipt stamp.
